judge.rationale: The candidate completely failed to implement the actual feature: `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` (adding `ajv`) were not modified at all. Because the implementation is missing, the newly added acceptance tests will fail. Additionally, the test files were named `*.acceptance.test.ts` instead of the ticket-specified `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and `example/weather-tool.ts` was not updated to match the doc block in `docs/adding-a-tool.md`. Only the documentation updates (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`) and test scaffolding were produced.
